test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Anant was recording a new song in his studio.

options.text: In his studio Anant will record a new song.
A new song had been recorded by Anant in his studio.
In his studio a new song was recorded by Anant.
A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.

solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. '****A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **given sentence is in the Active Voice**. As per the given direction,** we have to change the sentence into Passive form. **
 
• The given sentence is written in** ‘Past continuous form. **
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• **Active Voice:** Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object.
 
• **Passive Voice:** Subject (Objective Case) + was/were + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case) 
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• **Active voice:** Sapna was writing a poem in the notebook.
 
• **Passive voice:** A poem was being written by Sapna in the notebook.
 
 
 
• The **subject of the given sentence is '****Anant****'** and **the object of the given sentence is '****a new song'. **
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of **‘subject’ **and **‘object’ **will be interchanged**. **
 
• Also here, **'****was recording****'**** **will be changed into** ****'****was being recorded.'**
 
• So, **the correct answer is option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *A new song was being recorded by Anant in his studio.*
